description:
Basic Information

  • Full Programme Name: EPSRC Energy Transfer Technologies Doctoral Training Hub
  • Host Institution: University of Liverpool
  • Funding Body: EPSRC (Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council)
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 4 years
  • Start Date: October 2026
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: At least £25,805 per year (enhanced rate)
  • Additional Funding: £7,000 per year for travel, conferences, and research equipment
  • Disciplines: Physics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Chemistry
  • Eligibility: Open to UK and international students
  • Application Deadline: Open for October 2026 intake

About the Programme

The Doctoral Training Hub specialises in developing research and training the next generation of leaders in energy transfer technologies for defence and related sectors. The programme offers the opportunity to collaborate with academic and industry experts across multiple disciplines. Students receive enhanced financial support and access to a strong academic and industrial network, structured training, and professional development opportunities.

Research Focus

  • Energy transfer technologies for defence and related sectors
  • High Power Laser Development
  • Atmospheric Plasma Polymer Coatings and Sensor Integration for Harsh Energy & Defence Environments

Why This Programme?

  • Enhanced stipend (£4,000 above standard UKRI rate)
  • Additional £7,000 annual research budget
  • Industry-focused research
  • Multi-disciplinary collaboration

Eligibility Requirements

  • First Class or 2:1 Honours degree in physics, engineering, chemistry, or related discipline
  • Relevant Master's degree preferred
  • International students welcome
  • IELTS 6.5 (minimum) for non-native English speakers

How to Apply

Apply via the University of Liverpool's postgraduate research portal. Select Energy Transfer Technologies Hub.
